items.title: Pretty big win for the Heat that Klay Thompson took less than the originally reported salary - $11.5M vs $13M.
items.author: KeithSmithNBA
items.body_excerpt:
Pretty big win for the Heat that Klay Thompson took less than the originally reported salary - $11.5M vs $13M.

It may not seem like much overall but starting around $5.6M vs $6.3M gave the Heat room to sign two vet minimum deals. Huge for a team that still needs depth.
